silhouette.reason: Diamond-less tall stack, domes, bell, headlamp, cowcatcher, cab and tender read as an 1880s 4-4-0 in every view.
fixes: flared balloon stack top a touch wider

proportions.reason: 4-4-0 wheel arrangement, drivers and boiler length read right; the tender is a plain box and the cab roof overhang is generous.
fixes: tender sides with flare and coping
check the cab roof overhang against the Jupiter replica photos

materials.reason: Paint, brass, black iron and wood separate; the blue is a flat saturated plastic and the brass and black boiler share one sheen.
fixes: clearcoat paint with orange-peel roughness on the blue
polished brass (metal, low roughness) on the domes and bands

detail.reason: Spoked drivers, rods, crossheads, bell, sand and steam domes, piping, lettered panels and sleepers; no rivets on the smokebox, no lining on the cab.
fixes: rivet rows on smokebox and firebox
pin-striping on the cab and tender panels

wear.reason: Showroom-clean: no soot on the stack, no oil on the motion, no rust.
fixes: soot down the stack and smokebox front
oil and grime on the motion and wheels

lod.reason: FAR LOD2 turns the spoked drivers into solid red blocks and the track into a white slab: colour and shape pop.
fixes: keep wheels as 8-sided discs with a dark hub at LOD2
keep the track colour (wood/steel) at LOD2
merge static body parts to cut draws; keep pivots only on wheels and rods
